title: Increment-counter action
statement: Let $r$ be one of $m$ Boolean work tapes, let $c_C,c_B$ be states, and let $rd$ be an optional Boolean read from tape $r$. If $rd$ is the bit $1$, the action writes $0$ on tape $r$, moves its head one cell right, and enters $c_C$. In every other case, it writes $1$ on tape $r$, moves its head one cell left, and enters $c_B$.
